body:
Thank you all for attending the meeting yesterday! Here are the notes from this meeting (the next one is at https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10254):

### Agenda

Attendees: Michael Smith, Joey Arhar, Mason Freed, Sanket Joshi, Brian Kardell, Chris Wilson, Panos Astithas

1. Review past action items
    1. Dominic will tag [Atomic move operation for element reparenting & reordering](https://github.com/whatwg/dom/issues/1255) with `stage-1`.
        1. Done.
    1. Olli will ping Domenic about [Focus delegate algorithm doesn't consider elements assigned to slot](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9245).
        1. [smaug] started to think about a solution which would let one choose the behavior, but need to think about that some more. 
        1. Mason wonders why we need an attribute at all.
        1. Mason will ping Domenic.
1. Carryovers from last time
    1. [Kara] [Image loading on page load](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10056)
        1. Defer until 4/11.
1. New topics
    1. [Mason] [Add anchor attribute](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/9144)
        1. Mason summarized the spec PR and would love a review soon.

### Action Items

1. @mfreed7 will ping @domenic about [Focus delegate algorithm doesn't consider elements assigned to slot](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9245).
